title: A CLAP width the plugin's ports cannot serve is refused, not rendered as silence

needles: declares {} input / {} output channel(s) and cannot
void set_preferred_channel_layout(int inputs, int outputs) override
CLAP prepare refuses a width the plugin's ports cannot serve
no request means nothing is policed

installed_sdk.rationale: PluginSlot::prepare is declared in the installed header core/host/include/pulp/host/plugin_slot.hpp, and core/host/include/pulp/ is installed by the per-subsystem header loop in PulpInstallRules.cmake. An SDK consumer that calls set_preferred_channel_layout and then prepare now observes a false return where it previously observed success followed by a silent render, so the behaviour change is reachable from the installed surface.

offline_timeline_cli.rationale: No timeline CLI verb, flag or handler changes. The caller whose behaviour moves is `pulp audio render`, which is the offline plugin-render command rather than a timeline surface; it now exits non-zero instead of writing a silent WAV.

offline_timeline_mcp.rationale: No MCP tool definition or handler changes; no MCP surface prepares a CLAP slot.

live_product_control.rationale: A refusal at prepare is not a musician-facing control. A shipped product picks a width its own plugin declares, so this path is not reachable as an operation; it changes what an offline measurement does when asked for an impossible shape.

design_time_agent_manifest.rationale: No capability key is added or changed. The refusal tightens an existing PluginSlot behaviour rather than publishing a new capability for an agent to discover.
